U.note: Light, legible calculator with live region, keyboard, 12-digit cap and a clear friendly divide-by-zero message; C and CE side by side is slightly redundant.

V.note: Clean dark calculator with a wide zero, big readable display, caps at 12 digits, aria-live and keyboard support; the Error message is terse but fine.

W.note: Familiar iOS-style layout that is compact and correct, but the display is small, AC/C label flips and the percent key goes slightly beyond basic.

X.note: Charming segment-LCD skeuomorph, but limited to 9 digits, heavy rendering code and decorative extras overbuild a basic calculator.

Y.note: Small, tidy code and correct maths, but almost no aria, a tiny divide-by-zero message and a low-contrast operator colour.

Z.note: Most polished retro LCD with printed keyboard hints and good accessibility, but it is the largest source and clearly overbuilt for a basic calculator.
